notes.title: Happy 1 Year Anniversary to Plunker!
notes.content:
I just wanted to say thanks to everyone who has played, watched, laughed at, loved, and hated Plunker. Out of everything that I've ever made, Plunker has been my longest term and largest project, and so it was really hard to predict if it would ever be played by people who would appreciate the humor and work that went into it. After seeing people play it live on Twitch, or in recorded streams like Techmon's below, I'm really happy that I finished and released it and seeing people rofl is one of my favorite feelings. Thanks again to everyone.
[previewyoutube=HK24pug0h98;full][/previewyoutube]

P.S. keep an eye out for a small upcoming patch and price change.

notes.title: Finally Releasing
notes.content: I don't think this is the place to talk at length about these decisions, but I am lowering the price to $9.99 because I think that's fair and I would rather make it cheaper than box friends and potential fans out. If you find any bugs please report them to me as soon as possible and I can fix them ASAP! Hope ya enjoyit.
